cue: A new solution or novelty claim is about to be made for a named open problem
fire_when: About to call a candidate proof a new solution of a named conjecture
silent_when: Reproducing a known special case with no novelty claim
text: Check the problem status and prior attempts before verifying novelty. A correct proof and a new proof are different claims; cached status stays dated.

cue: Floating-point LP output is being described as an exact feasibility certificate
fire_when: HiGHS reports zero residual and the result is about to be labelled exact
silent_when: A rational point has been independently replayed with all marginals exactly correct
text: A float LP can propose a support. Before calling it exact, check a rational point for nonnegative masses and every required marginal.
evidence: measurements/C0034.json: 64 rational replays; measurements/C0034_higher_rank_summary.json: 8 rational replays, residual exactly 0

cue: A colour-word-only site-percolation state is proposed without a proved simple boundary
fire_when: Compressing site exploration on a nonsimple boundary to its colour word
silent_when: A simple boundary is proved or the state already includes vertex incidence identities
text: Site colours belong to vertices. On a nonsimple boundary repeated occurrences share a label; retain the incidence partition before claiming a word is Markov.
evidence: measurements/C0058.json: identical UUUU states have colour-law TV 1/2 at p=1/2

cue: A logical store target is resolved by substring search over the full metadata_json
fire_when: Using metadata_json LIKE %c0151% to identify a problem card
silent_when: Querying the logical_id field and verifying the exact target
text: Resolve a store edge through the logical_id field. Full-metadata substring searches can match hashes; confirm the target identity before writing an edge.
evidence: reports/metadata_substring_false_matches.json: all 3 first matches were false logical targets
